pages.text: Burns any furnace fuel at furnace speed into **40 FE per tick** (64,000 FE per coal), storing 50,000 FE.

**Fuel:** right-click to open, or feed with hoppers from above and the sides.

**Output:** pushes up to 1,000 FE per tick into each neighbouring block that takes energy. Next to a [[charging_rail]] it keeps the rail charged; under the track it charges passing locomotives directly.

It stops lighting new fuel when its buffer is full.
